mapper.select: select count(*) from oa_sign_onboard_data_request d inner join oa_sign_onboard_import_row r on r.data_request_id = d.request_id and r.row_id = d.row_id and r.batch_id = d.batch_id and r.employee_id = d.employee_id inner join oa_sign_task t on t.task_id = r.task_id and t.package_id = r.package_id and t.employee_id = r.employee_id and upper(trim(t.scenario)) = 'ONBOARD' and upper(trim(t.source_type)) = 'MANUAL_SIGN_EXCEL_IMPORT' and t.source_business_id = cast(r.row_id as char) and t.source_event_version = cast(r.source_event_version as char) inner join oa_sign_package p on p.package_id = r.package_id and p.task_id = r.task_id and p.employee_id = r.employee_id and p.shop_dept_id = t.shop_dept_id and p.plan_version_id = t.plan_version_id and upper(trim(p.signing_sequence)) = 'SIGNATURE_FIRST' where t.task_id = #{taskId} and p.package_id = #{packageId} and d.employee_id = #{employeeId} and t.status = #{currentTaskStatus} and p.status = #{currentPackageStatus} and ( (#{currentTaskStatus} = 'PENDING_SIGN' and #{currentPackageStatus} = 'pending_sign') or (#{currentTaskStatus} = 'VIEWED' and #{currentPackageStatus} = 'part_viewed') ) and upper(trim(d.signing_sequence)) = 'SIGNATURE_FIRST' and d.status in ( 'PENDING_EMPLOYEE', 'REJECTED', 'SUBMITTED', 'APPROVED', 'PROFILE_SYNC_FAILED', 'COMPLETED' ) and r.status in ( 'WAITING_EMPLOYEE_DATA', 'PENDING_HR_REVIEW', 'PROFILE_SYNC_APPLYING', 'PROFILE_SYNC_FAILED', 'READY_TO_GENERATE', 'GENERATE_FAILED' )
